profile.headline: Software Engineer @ WAB | VT Alum
profile.summary: Current Senior at Virginia Tech studying Computer Science with a minor in GIS. Proficient in Java, JS/TS, C, Python, ArcGIS, and experienced in React, MATLAB, Autodesk products, ERDAS IMAGINE, Git, and Linux.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Skills: AngularJS · Git · ASP.NET MVC · C#

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Created a full stack dashboard using React and C# tailored to the business intelligence team using existing frameworks and creating new ones in order for similar pages to be created
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Git · Swagger API · TypeScript · Bitbucket · C# · JavaScript · React.js

positions.title: Senior Assistant Coach
positions.description: Worked as a swim coach Fall 2018 and Summers 2019/2021. Coached kids ages 6-18 for two months alongside 6 other coaches. Collaborated with mangers of our team and others as well as parent volunteers to run meets and practices safely and efficiently.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description: Worked on developing documentation for the backend of an iOS and Android app written mostly with NodeJS. Also created a Python script that interacted with an API in order to automate some processes for HR.

positions.title: Lifeguard
positions.description: Lifeguard/Operator for 3 summers, most recently in 2019
